events.content:
Built a small, account-free reading tracker. The home page shows books in progress and finished; you can add a title, author, and notes, mark a book finished, and open its detail page. **Copy book link** creates a direct link to that book.

Books are stored in [data/books.json](/workspace/data/books.json) and persist across server restarts. Start the app with `npm run dev` and open `http://localhost:3000`.

The server is in [server.js](/workspace/server.js), and the browser app is in [public](/workspace/public). I didn’t run a test suite.

item.text:

Books are stored in [data/books.json](/workspace/data/books.json) and persist across server restarts. Start the app with `npm run dev` and open `http://localhost:3000`.

The server is in [server.js](/workspace/server.js), and the browser app is in [public](/workspace/public). I didn’t run a test suite.
